entities.summary: PostEurop is the association of European public postal operators, one of the constituent unions of the Universal Postal Union. PostEurop was created in 1993 to simplify the exchange of mail in Europe, a task previously undertaken by the European Conference of Postal and Telecommunications Administrations. A smaller but similar organization is the Small European Postal Administration Cooperation.
